name: Flügel ~Yakusoku no Aozora no Shita e~
original_name: フリューゲル～約束の青空の下へ～
source:
Humans divided into two categories - those who could use magic and those who could not. After invention of internal combustion engine the need in magicians waned and two factions began living isolated. 
One day a certain witch visits technology world...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人类分为两类：能够使用魔法的人，以及无法使用魔法的人。内燃机发明后，社会对魔法师的需求逐渐消失，两个群体也开始彼此隔绝地生活。

一天，一名魔女来到了科技一方的世界……

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
